Message.Name: Timestamp Seconds Message
Message.Description: Reflects the number of seconds past midnight that the Timestamp message was generated.

Field.Name: TimestampSeconds
Field.Description: Number of seconds since midnight of the day that the trading session started.

Message.Name: System Event Message
Message.Description: System Event Messages signal data feed, system and market events.

Field.Name: TimestampNanoseconds
Field.Description: Number of nanoseconds since last Timestamp Seconds Message.

Field.Name: Group
Field.Description: Orderbook group identifier.

Field.Name: SystemEvent
Field.Description: Refer to the System Events table below.

Message.Name: Price Tick Size Message
Message.Description: Price Tick Size Messages define a set of price tick size tables.

Field.Name: TimestampNanoseconds
Field.Description: Number of nanoseconds since last Timestamp Seconds Message.

Field.Name: PriceTickSizeTableId
Field.Description: Price tick size table identifier.

Field.Name: PriceTickSize
Field.Description: Price tick size.

Field.Name: PriceStart
Field.Description: Start of price range for this price tick size.

Message.Name: Orderbook Directory Message
Message.Description: Orderbook Directory Messages provide information about orderbooks available in the Japannext PTS execution system.

Field.Name: TimestampNanoseconds
Field.Description: Number of nanoseconds since last Timestamp Seconds Message.

Field.Name: OrderbookId
Field.Description: 4 digit Quick code.

Field.Name: OrderbookCode
Field.Description: International Securities Identification Number (ISIN).

Field.Name: Group
Field.Description: Orderbook group identifier.

Field.Name: RoundLotSize
Field.Description: Number of shares that represent a round lot.

Field.Name: PriceTickSizeTableId
Field.Description: Price tick size table identifier.

Field.Name: PriceDecimals
Field.Description: Number of decimal places in price fields; value is 1.

Field.Name: UpperPriceLimit
Field.Description: Maximum tradable price.

Field.Name: LowerPriceLimit
Field.Description: Minimum tradable price.

Message.Name: Trading State Message
Message.Description: Trading State Message indicates the current trading state of an orderbook.

Field.Name: TimestampNanoseconds
Field.Description: Number of nanoseconds since last Timestamp Seconds Message.

Field.Name: OrderbookId
Field.Description: 4 digit Quick code.

Field.Name: Group
Field.Description: Orderbook group identifier.

Field.Name: TradingState
Field.Description: Current trading state.

Message.Name: Short Selling Price Restriction State Message
Message.Description: Short Selling Price Restriction State Message indicates the current short selling price restriction state of an orderbook.

Field.Name: TimestampNanoseconds
Field.Description: Number of nanoseconds since last Timestamp Seconds Message.

Field.Name: OrderbookId
Field.Description: 4 digit Quick code.

Field.Name: Group
Field.Description: Orderbook group identifier; values include DAY (Daytime market), NGHT (Nighttime market), DAYX (X-Market), DAYU (U-Market).

Field.Name: ShortSellingState
Field.Description: Current short selling price restriction state; values: 0 = No price restriction, 1 = Price restriction in effect.

Message.Name: Order Added Without Attributes Message
Message.Description: Order Added Message will be generated for normal orders accepted by the system.

Field.Name: TimestampNanoseconds
Field.Description: Number of nanoseconds since last Timestamp Seconds Message.

Field.Name: OrderNumber
Field.Description: Reference number of the accepted order; zero indicates a reference price message.

Field.Name: BuySellIndicator
Field.Description: Side of the order.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Total number of shares added to the book.

Field.Name: OrderbookId
Field.Description: 4 digit Quick code.

Field.Name: Group
Field.Description: Orderbook group identifier.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Price of the order; for a reference price message, a value of 214,748,364.7 (7FFFFFFF hex) denotes no reference price available.

Message.Name: Order Added With Attributes Message
Message.Description: Order Added with Attributes Message will be generated for orders with market specific attributes accepted by the system.

Field.Name: TimestampNanoseconds
Field.Description: Number of nanoseconds since last Timestamp Seconds Message.

Field.Name: OrderNumber
Field.Description: Reference number of the accepted order.

Field.Name: BuySellIndicator
Field.Description: Side of the order.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Total number of shares added to the book.

Field.Name: OrderbookId
Field.Description: 4 digit Quick code.

Field.Name: Group
Field.Description: Orderbook group identifier.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Price of the order.

Field.Name: Attribution
Field.Description: Reserved; always blank.

Field.Name: OrderType
Field.Description: Type of the order.

Message.Name: Order Executed Message
Message.Description: Order Executed Message is sent whenever an order in the book is executed in whole or part.

Field.Name: TimestampNanoseconds
Field.Description: Number of nanoseconds since last Timestamp Seconds Message.

Field.Name: OrderNumber
Field.Description: Reference number of the executed order.

Field.Name: ExecutedQuantity
Field.Description: Number of shares executed.

Field.Name: MatchNumber
Field.Description: Reference number of the match.

Message.Name: Order Deleted Message
Message.Description: Order Deleted Message is sent whenever an order in the book has been canceled.

Field.Name: TimestampNanoseconds
Field.Description: Number of nanoseconds since last Timestamp Seconds Message.

Field.Name: OrderNumber
Field.Description: Reference number of the canceled order.

Message.Name: Order Replaced Message
Message.Description: Order Replaced Message is sent whenever an order in the book has been replaced.

Field.Name: TimestampNanoseconds
Field.Description: Number of nanoseconds since last Timestamp Seconds Message.

Field.Name: OriginalOrderNumber
Field.Description: Reference number of the original order.

Field.Name: NewOrderNumber
Field.Description: Reference number of the replaced order.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: New total number of shares displayed in the book.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: New price of the order.

Value.Name: Start of Messages
Value.Description: Always the first message sent in any trading day excepting Timestamp – Seconds Messages.

Value.Name: Start of System Hours
Value.Description: Indicates the market is open and ready to start accepting orders.

Value.Name: End of System Hours
Value.Description: Indicates the market is closed and will not accept any new orders.
